title: New expression-level multi-context simulation

reason: Generate only after the method commit and metric registry are frozen.

title: Tensor-cell2cell 12-context dynamic simulation
design: 12 contexts with four planted programs
reason: Upstream source is being pinned; expression/tensor truth has not yet been normalized to the common contract.

title: STACCato disease-batch simulation
design: balanced, partially confounded and extremely confounded sample designs
reason: Upstream source is being pinned; exact simulation entry point still requires an adapter.

title: DCST sample and cell-count power simulation
design: two groups with 5-55 subjects per group and 50-500 receiver cells
reason: Upstream source is being pinned; binary-link truth adapter is pending.

title: CRYCHIC frozen seven-scenario simulation suite
design: 8 paired subjects, two contexts, seven positive and negative-control scenarios
reason: Used during development; retain only for regression and adapter validation.

title: MIS-C, healthy siblings and adult severe COVID with Olink
design: three independent groups with family clusters and an external Olink protein contrast

title: Breast cancer anti-PD-1 Pre/On by expander status

title: Ji paired cSCC tumor-normal cohort
design: 10 paired patients, tumor versus normal
reason: Already used for adapter and method development; spatial evidence is supportive only.

title: Kuppe myocardial infarction multi-region cohort

reason: Used repeatedly in RC0-RC10; never describe as an independent holdout.

title: Lerma-Martin multiple-sclerosis lesion cohort

access: public processed portal; article CC BY-NC-ND
reason: Used repeatedly in RC0-RC10; CI has only two independent subjects.

title: Kang paired IFN-beta PBMC
design: 8 donors measured before and after stimulation
reason: Strong positive control already used for ligand-gate development.

title: COVID-19 PBMC severity contexts
